digest.component_or_area: test observability and editor server instrumentation
propositions: test_server_binds_loopback_only stalls for ~35 seconds consistently across macOS Gerrit Verify runs, traced to CPython ThreadingHTTPServer constructor synchronously invoking socket.getfqdn(127.0.0.1) which blocks on reverse DNS lookup

fixture-setup timing instrumentation with nested span measurement around ThreadingHTTPServer constructor, TCP bind, and socket.getfqdn call must attribute the delay and confirm the root cause without changing test behavior or semantics
instrumentation must remain silent outside CI environments or explicit REBAR_FIXTURE_TIMING=1 opt-in and emit only spans exceeding 1 second threshold to avoid noisy routine logs
organic post-merge macOS observation confirmed socket.getfqdn=35.013s and ThreadingHTTPServer constructor=35.014s as the blocking mechanism, ruling out TCP bind, tmp_path, and worker starvation
timing observer successfully merged and must be retained while a separate follow-up ticket implements the production fix to eliminate the irrelevant reverse DNS lookup
